content.text: As a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, you're all too familiar with the frustration of platform restrictions - Gumroad payout delays, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-15|Stripe Alternatives]] unavailability, and the constant search for reliable payment processing. This is where NOWPayments comes in, offering a seamless solution for receiving crypto payments for your digital products, with transaction fees as low as under $0.10 per transaction on Tron and fractions of a cent on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solana-payments-digital-products-every-detail-you-need-3|solana]].

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The NOWPayments infrastructure is designed to work around platform restrictions, providing a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you full control over your online store. With GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can deploy a fully operational store in 48 hours. This infrastructure is pressure-tested against actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation, making it the perfect solution for creators in regions with limited access to traditional payment platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to set up a few essential components. This includes choosing a hosting platform, selecting a backend logic tool, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-everything-you-need-12|COREMERCH guide to setting]] up order storage. You'll also need to create a NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, making it easy to get started with your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a straightforward process with NOWPayments. You'll need to configure your payment settings, including choosing the cryptocurrencies you want to accept and setting up your webhook. You'll also need to set up your delivery pipeline, including configuring your file storage and delivery settings. With USDT on Tron costing under $0.10 per transaction in network fees, you can offer your customers a fast and affordable payment option.
NOWPayments offers a seamless solution for receiving crypto payments for your digital products.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and process your first transaction. This is an exciting moment, as you'll be able to receive crypto payments for your digital products and start building a loyal customer base. With the NOWPayments dashboard, you can easily track your transactions and monitor your store's performance, making it easy to optimize and improve your sales funnel.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and scales, you'll need to ensure that your infrastructure can keep up with demand. This includes optimizing your hosting and backend logic, as well as scaling your order storage and delivery pipeline. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get access to a scaling playbook, making it easy to scale your sovereign digital commerce stack and reach a wider audience.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings. This includes choosing the cryptocurrencies you want to accept and setting up your webhook. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, and with transaction fees as low as under $0.10 per transaction on Tron, you can offer your customers a fast and affordable payment option.
Tron transaction fees are under $0.10 per transaction, making it a fast and affordable payment option.

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, be sure to check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, making it easy to get started with your online store and start receiving crypto payments for your digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: set up your hosting platform, select a backend logic tool, and configure your order storage. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings, including choosing the cryptocurrencies you want to accept and setting up your webhook. Set up your delivery pipeline, including configuring your file storage and delivery settings. Go live and process your first transaction, and then optimize and improve your sales funnel as you scale.

You can set up a webhook for your NOWPayments account by logging in to your dashboard and navigating to the settings page, where you can configure your webhook settings.

Tron transaction fees are under $0.10 per transaction, while Solana transaction fees are fractions of a cent, making Solana a more affordable option for small transactions.

You can optimize your sales funnel by tracking your transactions and monitoring your store's performance, and then making adjustments to your marketing and sales strategy as needed.
